metadata.description: APPROVED departure labels for members of Georgia's congressional delegation who do not return in the 120th Congress (rollover decision D12). Display text states only the fact and date; never 'retired', 'ousted' or 'unseated'; never names the winner of a contest the member lost; each label links the certified results page that sources it. Keyed by bioguideId. Shown only on a former member's page. Drafts live in docs/federal-departure-labels-draft.md until the site owner approves them; ONLY approved entries belong in this file.
